def transform(grid):
    sep = next(c for c in range(len(grid[0]))
               if len({row[c] for row in grid}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != 0)
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]
    return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(lrow, rrow)]
            for lrow, rrow in zip(left, right)]
